row:
Good Life Dog Rescue is a small charity who care about the welfare of stray dogs in the UK. We are passionate about helping these animals who often face an uncertain future. The rescue was established by a passionate animal lover who for over 8 years has been dedicated to helping stray and abandoned dogs in Yorkshire. The charity flys a flag high for the Staffies and cross Staffies who are often the last to find a rescue place.
Good Life Dog Rescue is self funded. We receive no immediate funding and survive on few donations and fundraising. We pay no wages and have no staff. The charity exists with volunteers who are mainly walkers. The founder has a full time job to part fund huge kennelling and veterinary bills.
Good Life Dog Rescue does not have its own kennels so all the dogs in our care board at kennels in South Yorkshire. All our dogs are walked and cared for and all veterinary care is paid for by our charity.
